_comment: The x509 browser flow, merged into the realm by deploy.sh when IR_PKI_LOGON=1.
Kept out of the realm file so an unconfigured deployment cannot import a certificate
flow it has no trust anchors for — that fails closed and locks everyone out.
ALTERNATIVE, not REQUIRED: a user without a card falls through to the password form.
Making the certificate mandatory here means an administrator whose card is unreadable
cannot reach the platform to fix it. Requiring cards is a policy decision to make once
cards are known to work, by setting this to REQUIRED.

authenticationExecutions.flowAlias_comment: the password path, for users and situations without a card

_comment: crl-checking on, crldp OFF: a distribution point is a URL, and the enclave has no
route to one. Revocation is checked against lists staged into crl/ instead.
OCSP is off for the same reason — it is a live call to a responder.
